title: Check TTO Creator Status
content_data:
Use this endpoint to check if TikTok users have already become TikTok One (TTO) Creators. You can check the statuses of up to 20 users at the same time, using `tto_tcm_account_id` and `handle_names`. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/creator/status/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by TTO Creator Marketplace accounts.
For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-authorization-and-authentication-from-a-tto-creator-marketplace-account/v1.3). | ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| | tto_tcm_account_id {Required} | string | The ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace account.

To obtain the IDs of the accounts that you can access via `Access-Token`, use [/tto/oauth2/tcm/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693478150146). | | handle_names {Required} | string[] | The handle names of TikTok Creators.

Max size: 20. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/creator/status/get/?tto_tcm_account_id={{tto_tcm_account_id}}&handle_names=["{{handle_name}}","{{handle_name}}","{{handle_name}}"]' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Information](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id|string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request.| |data |object|Returned data.| #|onboarding_status |object[]|The onboarding status data for Creators.| ##|handle_name |string|The handle name that was checked.| ##|status |string|The onboarding status of the Creator.

Enum values:
  • `IN`: The Creator has joined TTO Creator Marketplace.
  • `NOT_IN`: The Creator has not joined TTO Creator Marketplace.
  • `INVALID`: The specified handle name (`handle_name`) is invalid.
| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "onboarding_status": [ { "handle_name": "{{handle_name}}", "status": "NOT_IN" }, { "handle_name": "{{handle_name}}", "status": "IN" }, { "handle_name": "{{handle_name}}", "status": "INVALID" } ] } } (/code) ```
